Home | Platformatory | Forward Deployed Engineering Firm: Data, AI & Modernization Home Consulting Services Talks Write Ahead Log Company Data+AI Academy Home Consulting Services Talks Write Ahead Log Company Data+AI Academy We Engineer. Platforms & Products. Powered by real-time data & AI. Learn more → A unique thesis on building platforms & products, in the post AI world Every company is a data company In the AI economy, data intelligence is the primary alpha. Execution comes a close second. Build over buy Differentiation takes a certain level of bespoke. You can't buy that in a fair market. Don't invent infrastructure You cannot vibe-code a database—yet. Build on best-in-breed OSS that has stood the test of time. The compute continuum Compute is a continuum. Not every service needs to be a server. Platformify the product A platform-less product will always be replaced by an equivalent platform-ized product. Consultants must have skin in the game Consultants earn contempt not for telling you what you already know, but for having no skin in your game. Progress is not always incremental Many great advances arrive as leaps, not single-digit gains. Sometimes you can just run. One-pizza teams Small is purposeful and efficient. Large teams create overhead with diminishing returns. Built with AI, not built by AI You still can't build serious software autonomously. Taste of the discerning artist goes a long way. Roll your own When the problem is large enough, inventing infrastructure is worth it. Agentify everything UIs are fading into irrelevance. The AI harness is the touch point of multimodal interaction with your service. Run anywhere, everywhere The future is hybrid. Hyperscaler portability lets you command the best price. Practice over preaching Trust those who can do over those who talk. Protocol over platform The right protocol gives you platform fungibility for five years—maybe fifty. Co-create Creating alpha requires expertise, not headcount. Build with the best in the business. Build and operate The best teams build what they operate and operate what they build. Pay for what you use, strictly Price on value created—not seats, capacity, or headcount. AI is utility-like fuel for industrialized value creation. Real-time data (and everything else) Real-time context is the line between intelligent systems and non-intelligent ones. Performance matters Features become commodity. Real differentiation is price—and therefore performance. Infrastructure companies and everyone else AI is eating the middle layer. Paying for CRUD and commodity analytics is no longer sensible. Compute is the real moat Unit economics of software reduce to a premium on compute—and the efficiencies thereof. Code is cheap, show me the numbers Application-layer coding costs ~0. Everyone has the same models. Impact must be measurable—code is not the benchmark. Taste matters Everyone has the same frontier models. Human intelligence is the department of taste. AI is still a stochastic parrot You can't fire your agent from the job. Accountability and guardrails lie with humans.
